pillars.name: Education
pillars.body: Each semester, our new class of analysts participates in a rigorous curriculum that encompasses an overview of private financial markets, the capital deployment process, and technical skill development.

pillars.name: Immersion
pillars.body: CCG members participate in a case study of the private market investment process within a sector that interests them. Members develop a comprehensive deal report which is presented to the group at the end of the semester. Teams source potential investments, perform due diligence, and deliver a final presentation with their investment recommendation.

pillars.name: Network
pillars.body: By cultivating a network of diverse, business-focused individuals interested in the private financial markets, we are the primary contact point for PE/VC recruiting at Vanderbilt. Our speaker series of industry leaders gives members the opportunity to expand their network and learn more about the industry.

faqs.a: Commodore Capital Group is Vanderbilt's first student organization dedicated to the private markets. In CCG, we explore private equity, venture capital, and other alternative asset classes through an immersive curriculum, hands-on projects, and leading guest speakers.

faqs.q: What do we look for in an applicant?
faqs.a: When reviewing resumes and applications, we look for demonstrated passion and interest in furthering your knowledge of financial topics. We are looking primarily for freshmen and sophomores looking to go into high finance roles within PE, IB, hedge funds, private credit, etc. While prior internship or work experience within these fields is definitely a plus, we do not in the slightest mandate that applicants must have prior experience to be admitted. We particularly look for demonstrated personal, academic, and professional excellence throughout the various aspects of your career at Vanderbilt.

faqs.q: Is there a specific resume format that CCG looks for?
faqs.a: While we do not have a specific resume format that we look for, we encourage applicants to consult the Vanderbilt AKPsi website for guidance with your resume; they have a professional resume template that many of our successful applicants have used.

faqs.q: Are there any specific procedures to follow in the application process?
faqs.a: Because we review applications anonymously, please remove your name, hometown, Greek affiliations, and any other information that could be used to personally identify you from your resume. Additionally, please do not include your first or last name in the title of your PDF document.

faqs.q: What does the application consist of?
faqs.a: The first round application consists of a few brief introductory questions and a resume drop. The second round will require you to submit a video answering a few short questions. The final round will be an interview with our team that will contain a behavioral portion and basic technical questions.
You should expect to dedicate between 1–3 hours per week to CCG, which includes both our general meeting time as well as any additional work that may be completed on your own time.
CCG meets once a week, at a time set by the availability of the newest analyst class.

faqs.q: Whom can I contact if I have additional questions?
faqs.a: Feel free to contact the executive board — their emails and LinkedIn profiles are on the Our Team page.
